recipes.name: Apricot Chicken with Roasted Zucchini
ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Scatter onion in a baking dish and top with seasoned chicken.
Mix jam and broth; pour over the chicken.
Bake 40 minutes, basting once; add zucchini tossed with oil for the last 20 minutes.
Spoon the sweet sauce over rice or potatoes if you like; shred for the toddler.

recipes.name: Baked Chicken Tenders
ingredients: 1.5 lb chicken breast, cut into strips
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F and set up flour, egg, and seasoned breadcrumb stations.
Dredge each strip through flour, egg, then breadcrumbs.
Arrange on a lined sheet pan; spray lightly with oil.
Bake 18-20 minutes, flipping once, until golden and cooked through.

recipes.name: Baked Cod with Roasted Vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Toss vegetables with half the oil on a sheet pan.
Roast vegetables 10 minutes, then nestle cod on top with remaining oil, lemon, and oregano.
Bake 12-15 minutes more until fish flakes easily.
Check carefully for bones before serving to the toddler.

recipes.name: Baked Salmon with Rice & Broccoli
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Whisk soy sauce, honey, and garlic for a glaze.
Brush salmon with glaze; toss broccoli with oil alongside on a sheet pan.
Bake 15 minutes until salmon flakes easily.
Serve over rice; check carefully for bones in the toddler's portion.

recipes.name: Baked Ziti
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Cook ziti until just under al dente.
Toss pasta with marinara and ricotta; spread in a baking dish.
Top with mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake 20 minutes until bubbly and golden. Cool before serving to the toddler.
sides: Big green salad with olive oil and lemon

recipes.name: BBQ Chicken Meatballs & Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes until fork-tender, about 15 minutes; mash with margarine.
Mix chicken, breadcrumbs, and egg; roll into 16 meatballs.
Bake at 400°F for 18 minutes, then toss with BBQ sauce.
Serve over mashed potatoes.

recipes.name: Beef & Barley Soup
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, small cubes
instructions: Brown beef in oil, then add onion, carrots, and celery for 4 minutes.
Add broth, barley, and bay leaf; bring to a boil.
Simmer covered 30 minutes until beef and barley are tender.
Cool a bowl and mash lightly for the toddler.

recipes.name: Beef & Broccoli Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 lb flank or minute steak, thinly sliced
instructions: Whisk soy sauce, brown sugar, cornstarch, and 3 tbsp water for the sauce.
Sear beef in hot oil 2-3 minutes; remove.
Stir-fry broccoli 4 minutes, then return beef and add sauce until glossy.
Serve over rice, chopped small for the toddler.

recipes.name: Beef & Vegetable Soup
instructions: Brown beef in oil over medium-high heat, 5 minutes.
Add onion, carrots, and celery; sauté 4 minutes.
Add broth and potatoes; simmer covered 20-25 minutes until beef is tender.
Cool and mash a small portion for the toddler.

recipes.name: Beef & Veggie Fried Rice
instructions: Brown beef in oil 5 minutes; push aside and scramble the eggs.
Add vegetables and rice; stir-fry 4 minutes.
Season with soy sauce.
Serve warm, mild on the soy for the toddler.

recipes.name: Beef Kofta with Rice
instructions: Mix beef, crumbs, egg, spices, and parsley; shape into small logs.
Pan-sear or bake at 425°F for 12-15 minutes, turning once.
Serve over rice with chopped cucumber and tomato.
Cut koftas into bite-size pieces for the toddler.

recipes.name: Black Bean & Cheese Burritos
instructions: Warm beans, mashing slightly.
Fill tortillas with beans, rice, cheese, and salsa; roll up.
Toast seam-side down in a dry skillet 2 minutes per side.
Cut into rounds for the toddler.

recipes.name: Breakfast-for-Dinner Pancakes & Eggs
ingredients: 2 cups pancake mix plus milk and egg per package
instructions: Mix batter per package and cook pancakes on a buttered griddle.
Scramble eggs softly in butter.
Serve with fruit and a little syrup.
Cut pancakes into strips for the toddler.

recipes.name: Cheese Blintzes with Berries
instructions: Pan-fry blintzes in butter 3-4 minutes per side until golden.
Top with berries and a spoonful of sour cream.
Cut into small pieces for the toddler.

recipes.name: Cheese Quesadillas & Black Beans
ingredients: 1 cup black beans, drained and rinsed
Sour cream and salsa, for serving
instructions: Warm beans with cumin in a small pot, mashing lightly.
Sprinkle cheese over half of each tortilla and fold over.
Melt butter in a skillet; cook quesadillas 2-3 minutes per side until golden.
Slice into wedges; serve with beans. Cut toddler portions into strips.
sides: Sliced peppers and cucumber with guacamole

recipes.name: Cheese Ravioli with Brown Butter
instructions: Cook ravioli in salted boiling water according to package directions.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat until lightly golden and nutty.
Toss drained ravioli in the butter; top with parmesan.
Serve with steamed green beans; cut ravioli in half for the toddler.

recipes.name: Cheesy Broccoli Rice Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Melt butter, whisk in flour, then milk to make a light sauce.
Stir in half the cheese until melted.
Combine sauce with rice and broccoli in a baking dish; top with remaining cheese.
Bake 15 minutes until bubbly. Cool before serving to the toddler.

recipes.name: Cheesy Cauliflower Mac
instructions: Cook macaroni with cauliflower for the last 5 minutes; drain.
Make a sauce with butter, flour, and milk; melt in cheese.
Combine and serve; mash cauliflower lightly for the toddler.

recipes.name: Cheesy Veggie Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F; pre-bake crust 8 minutes.
Whisk eggs and milk; add cheese and vegetables.
Pour into the crust and bake 30 minutes until set.
Cool a slice before serving.
sides: Mixed green salad with lemon dressing

recipes.name: Chicken & Veggie Lo Mein
instructions: Cook noodles and drain.
Sear chicken in oil 5 minutes; add vegetables for 4 minutes.
Add noodles, soy sauce, and sesame oil; toss.
Cut noodles shorter for the toddler.

recipes.name: Chicken Fajita Bowls
instructions: Toss chicken with seasoning and half the oil.
Sear chicken in a hot skillet 6-7 minutes; remove.
Sauté peppers and onion in remaining oil until softened, 5 minutes.
Return chicken to pan and toss together. Serve over rice or in tortillas.

recipes.name: Chicken Schnitzel with Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 2 cucumbers, sliced, with lemon and olive oil
instructions: Set up flour, egg, and breadcrumb stations; season each with salt.
Dredge cutlets through flour, egg, then crumbs.
Pan-fry in 1/2 inch hot oil 3-4 minutes per side until golden; drain on paper towels.
Serve with cucumber salad; slice into strips for the toddler.

recipes.name: Chicken Shawarma Wraps
instructions: Toss chicken with oil and spice; let sit 10 minutes if you have time.
Roast at 425°F 18-20 minutes or sear in a hot pan.
Warm pitas and fill with chicken, vegetables, and tahini.
Chop chicken small for the toddler and serve vegetables on the side.

recipes.name: Chickpea & Veggie Curry
instructions: Sauté onion in oil until soft, 4 minutes. Stir in curry powder for 30 seconds.
Add chickpeas, vegetables, and coconut milk; simmer 15 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Serve over rice; mash a portion lightly for the toddler and go mild on spice.

recipes.name: Classic Roast Chicken with Root Vegetables
ingredients: 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Toss vegetables with half the oil and seasoning in a roasting pan.
Rub the chicken with remaining oil and spices; stuff the cavity with lemon and place on top of the vegetables.
Roast about 70 minutes until juices run clear (165°F in the thigh), stirring the vegetables once.
Rest 10 minutes, carve, and serve with soft roasted vegetables; shred a portion for the toddler.

recipes.name: Egg & Veggie Fried Rice
ingredients: 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil
instructions: Scramble eggs in oil; set aside.
Cook peas and carrots in remaining oil, 3 minutes.
Add rice, breaking up clumps; stir-fry 3-4 minutes.
Return eggs, stir in soy sauce and sesame oil.
Top with green onion; hold onion and ease up on soy sauce for the toddler.

recipes.name: Eggplant Parmesan Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Dip slices in egg, then crumbs; bake on oiled sheets 15 minutes.
Layer in a dish with sauce and mozzarella.
Bake 15 minutes until bubbly.
Serve soft pieces to the toddler.

recipes.name: Falafel Bowls with Hummus & Pita
instructions: Bake or pan-fry falafel according to package directions.
Warm pitas; assemble bowls with falafel, hummus, cucumber, and tomatoes, drizzled with oil.
Mash falafel and pair with plain hummus and soft pita for the toddler.

recipes.name: Fettuccine Alfredo with Broccoli
instructions: Cook pasta, adding broccoli in the last 3 minutes; drain.
Melt butter with garlic, add cream, and simmer 3 minutes.
Stir in parmesan until smooth; toss with pasta and broccoli.
Chop small for the toddler.

recipes.name: Fish Sticks & Sweet Potato Wedges
instructions: Roast wedges with oil at 425°F for 25 minutes.
Bake fish sticks per package directions.
Serve with a vegetable on the side.

recipes.name: Garlic-Rosemary Roast Chicken with Broccoli & Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 1 whole chicken (about 4 lb), or 8 bone-in pieces
2 sprigs rosemary (or 1 tsp dried), salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Toss sweet potatoes and garlic with half the oil in a roasting pan.
Rub chicken with remaining oil, rosemary, and salt; set on top.
Roast 60 minutes; add broccoli tossed with a little oil for the last 15 minutes.
Rest 10 minutes and carve; mash sweet potato for the toddler.

recipes.name: Grilled Cheese & Tomato Soup
instructions: Simmer tomatoes with butter 10 minutes; blend or mash smooth, then stir in milk.
Butter bread on the outside; build sandwiches with cheese.
Grill sandwiches 3-4 minutes per side until golden and melty.
Cut into dippable strips for the toddler; serve with soup.

recipes.name: Ground Beef Tacos
ingredients: Shredded lettuce, diced tomato, salsa, avocado
instructions: Brown beef in a skillet over medium-high heat, 6-7 minutes.
Stir in seasoning and water; simmer until thickened.
Warm tortillas.
Fill and top. Serve the toddler's portion deconstructed or finely chopped.

recipes.name: Herb-Roasted Chicken Legs with Green Beans & Potatoes
ingredients: 1 tsp dried thyme, 1 tsp oregano, garlic powder, salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Toss potatoes with half the oil and roast 10 minutes.
Rub chicken with remaining oil, herbs, and lemon; add to the pan with green beans.
Roast 35-40 minutes until the chicken is browned and cooked through.
Serve with soft green beans and potatoes, chicken shredded for the toddler.

recipes.name: Honey Garlic Chicken Drumsticks
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Whisk honey, soy sauce, garlic, and oil.
Toss drumsticks in the glaze on a lined sheet pan.
Bake 30 minutes, basting once, until cooked through and sticky.
Serve over rice; pull meat off the bone for the toddler.

recipes.name: Honey-Glazed Roast Chicken & Carrots
ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp soy sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Toss carrots with oil and spread on a sheet pan.
Whisk honey, soy sauce, and garlic; toss with the chicken and nestle among the carrots.
Roast 45-50 minutes, basting once, until golden and cooked through.
Pull meat from the bone for the toddler.

recipes.name: Hummus Veggie Wraps
instructions: Spread hummus over wraps.
Layer vegetables and roll tightly.
Slice into pinwheels; serve with fruit.

recipes.name: Instant Pot Beef Ragu over Pasta
ingredients: 1 cup broth, 1 tsp Italian herbs, salt
instructions: Sauté onion, carrots, and garlic 4 minutes; add beef, tomatoes, broth, and herbs.
Pressure cook on High 35 minutes with natural release.
Shred the beef right in the sauce.
Toss with cooked pasta; cut noodles short for the toddler.
sides: Big green salad with olive oil and lemon

recipes.name: Instant Pot Black Bean Soup
ingredients: Rice, avocado, and lime to serve
instructions: Add all ingredients to the pot—no soaking needed.
Pressure cook on High 35 minutes with natural release.
Mash some beans for a thicker soup.
Serve over rice; blend a toddler portion smooth if you like.

recipes.name: Instant Pot Chicken & Rice
ingredients: 1 tbsp oil, 1 tsp paprika, garlic powder, salt
instructions: Sauté onion in oil on Sauté for 3 minutes; add seasoned chicken and sear 2 minutes per side.
Add rice and broth; scrape the bottom well.
Pressure cook on High 8 minutes with a natural release of 10 minutes.
Stir in peas, shred the chicken, and fluff the rice.

recipes.name: Instant Pot Chicken Soup with Noodles
ingredients: 1 whole chicken, cut up, or 3 lb bone-in pieces
instructions: Add chicken, vegetables, and water to the pot.
Pressure cook on High 25 minutes with natural release.
Remove chicken, shred the meat, and return to the broth.
Add noodles on Sauté for 6 minutes and serve; keep pieces small for the toddler.

recipes.name: Instant Pot Honey Garlic Chicken
instructions: Whisk honey, soy sauce, garlic, and ketchup in the pot; add chicken.
Pressure cook on High 8 minutes with natural release of 5 minutes.
Remove chicken, simmer sauce on Sauté 3 minutes to thicken, then toss together.
Serve over rice; shred for the toddler.

recipes.name: Instant Pot Mac & Cheese
instructions: Add macaroni, water, butter, and salt to the pot.
Pressure cook on High 4 minutes with quick release.
Stir in milk and cheese until silky; fold in peas.
Cool a portion before serving to the toddler.

recipes.name: Instant Pot Parmesan Veggie Risotto
ingredients: 1 cup frozen peas, 1 cup diced zucchini
instructions: Sauté onion in butter 3 minutes; add rice and stir 1 minute.
Add broth; pressure cook on High 6 minutes with quick release.
Stir in vegetables and parmesan until creamy.
Serve warm; the soft texture suits toddlers.

recipes.name: Instant Pot Red Lentil Dal
ingredients: 1 onion, diced, 3 cloves garlic, 1 tbsp ginger
2 tsp mild curry powder, 1/2 tsp turmeric, salt
instructions: Sauté onion, garlic, and ginger 3 minutes; stir in spices.
Add lentils, tomatoes, and water.
Pressure cook on High 8 minutes with natural release.
Stir until creamy; serve over rice, mild for the toddler.

recipes.name: Instant Pot Shredded Chicken Burrito Bowls
ingredients: 1 cup water or broth, 2 tsp taco seasoning
instructions: Add rice, water, seasoning, and half the salsa to the pot; lay chicken on top with the remaining salsa.
Pressure cook on High 10 minutes with a 10-minute natural release.
Shred the chicken and stir in the black beans.
Build bowls with corn and avocado.

recipes.name: Instant Pot Sweet Potato & Chickpea Curry
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic with curry powder 3 minutes.
Add sweet potatoes, chickpeas, and coconut milk.
Pressure cook on High 5 minutes with quick release.
Stir in spinach until wilted and serve over rice.

recipes.name: Kosher Hot Dogs & Baked Beans
instructions: Warm beans in a small pot over medium-low heat.
Grill or pan-sear hot dogs until heated through and lightly charred, 6-8 minutes.
Serve in buns with beans on the side; slice into coins for the toddler.

recipes.name: Lasagna Roll-Ups
instructions: Cook noodles; mix ricotta, egg, and spinach.
Spread filling on each noodle, roll, and set in a sauced dish.
Top with sauce and mozzarella; bake at 375°F for 25 minutes.
Cut rolls into small bites.

recipes.name: Lemon Garlic Tilapia with Rice
instructions: Season fillets and sear in oil 3 minutes per side with garlic.
Squeeze lemon over the top.
Serve with rice and green beans; flake and check for bones.

recipes.name: Lemon Herb Chicken Cutlets & Green Beans
instructions: Toss cutlets with oil, lemon, and spices.
Sear 4 minutes per side until cooked through.
Steam or sauté green beans 5 minutes.
Slice chicken thinly and serve with beans.

recipes.name: Lentil Bolognese over Pasta
ingredients: 1 cup brown or green lentils, rinsed
instructions: Sauté onion and carrot; add lentils, water, and marinara.
Simmer 25 minutes until lentils are tender.
Serve over cooked spaghetti; cut noodles short for the toddler.

recipes.name: Lentil Soup with Crusty Bread
instructions: Sauté onion and carrots in oil 5 minutes.
Add lentils, broth, and cumin; simmer 20 minutes until lentils are soft.
Blend partially for a creamier texture if the toddler prefers it smooth.
Serve with bread for dipping.

recipes.name: Loaded Baked Potatoes with Veggie Chili
instructions: Bake or microwave potatoes until soft.
Sauté onion and pepper; add beans, tomatoes, and spices; simmer 15 minutes.
Split potatoes and top with chili; mild for the toddler.

recipes.name: Mac and Cheese with Peas
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions; add peas in the last 2 minutes to warm through.
Melt butter, whisk in flour, then milk; simmer until thickened.
Stir in cheese until smooth, then fold in macaroni and peas.
Cool slightly before serving to the toddler.

recipes.name: Maple Mustard Chicken Thighs
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F; whisk maple, mustard, and oil.
Toss thighs and halved potatoes with the glaze on a sheet pan.
Roast 30 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Shred or dice chicken for the toddler.

recipes.name: Meatball Sliders
instructions: Mix beef, crumbs, egg, and seasoning; roll 16 small meatballs.
Bake at 400°F for 15 minutes.
Warm in marinara for 3 minutes.
Tuck two meatballs into each bun; serve with corn.

recipes.name: Mild Moroccan Chickpea Stew
instructions: Sauté onion and carrots in oil; add spices.
Add chickpeas, tomatoes, and broth; simmer 20 minutes.
Serve over couscous; mash a little for the toddler.

recipes.name: Naan Pizzas
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F; brush naan with oil.
Spread sauce, add cheese and toppings.
Bake 8-10 minutes until bubbly.
Cut into small squares for the toddler.

recipes.name: One-Pan Chicken & Rice
instructions: Brown seasoned chicken in a wide pan 4 minutes per side; remove.
Sauté onion, add rice and broth, bring to a simmer.
Nestle chicken on top, cover, and cook 20 minutes.
Stir in peas, rest 5 minutes, and shred chicken for the toddler.

recipes.name: One-Pot Beef Taco Pasta
instructions: Brown beef 6 minutes in a large pot.
Add pasta, water, salsa, and seasoning; bring to a boil.
Simmer covered 12 minutes until pasta is tender; stir in corn.
Serve; let the toddler's portion cool first.

recipes.name: One-Pot Black Bean & Veggie Rice
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes with green chiles (mild)
instructions: Sauté pepper in oil 3 minutes; add rice and cumin for 1 minute.
Add broth, tomatoes, and beans; bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer 18 minutes; stir in corn and rest 5 minutes.
Serve with avocado.

recipes.name: One-Pot Cheese Tortellini Soup
instructions: Simmer carrots, onion, tomatoes, broth, and herbs 10 minutes.
Add tortellini and cook per package directions.
Wilt in spinach; top with parmesan.
Cut tortellini in half for the toddler.

recipes.name: One-Pot Creamy Tomato Pasta
instructions: Combine pasta, marinara, and water in a large pot; bring to a boil.
Simmer covered 12 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in cream, spinach, and parmesan until melted.
Cool and cut pasta small for the toddler.

recipes.name: One-Pot Kosher Sausage, Peppers & Rice
instructions: Brown sausage in oil 5 minutes; add onion and peppers for 4 minutes.
Stir in rice, broth, tomatoes, and spices.
Cover and simmer 20 minutes; rest 5 minutes and fluff.
Cut sausage into small coins for the toddler.

recipes.name: One-Pot Lemon Chicken & Orzo
ingredients: 4 chicken thighs, boneless, cut in chunks
instructions: Brown seasoned chicken in oil in a large pot, 5 minutes; set aside.
Sauté onion and garlic, add orzo and toast 1 minute.
Add broth, lemon, and chicken; simmer covered 12-14 minutes, stirring once.
Stir in peas and rest 5 minutes.

recipes.name: One-Pot Lemon Salmon & Rice
instructions: Bring rice, water, and salt to a simmer in a wide pot; cover and cook 10 minutes.
Lay salmon, lemon, and broccoli on top, drizzle with oil and garlic powder.
Cover and cook 10-12 minutes until rice is tender and salmon flakes.
Flake salmon, checking for bones, for the toddler.

recipes.name: One-Pot Mujaddara (Lentils & Rice)
ingredients: 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp cumin, salt
instructions: Caramelize onions in oil 15-20 minutes; set half aside.
Add lentils, water, cumin, and salt to the pot; simmer 15 minutes.
Add rice, cover, and cook 18 minutes more.
Top with the reserved onions and serve with salad.

recipes.name: One-Pot Pesto Orzo with Peas & Mozzarella
ingredients: 1 cup mozzarella pearls or shredded mozzarella
instructions: Toast orzo in oil 1 minute; add broth and simmer 9 minutes.
Stir in peas for the last 2 minutes.
Off the heat, fold in pesto and mozzarella until melty.

recipes.name: One-Pot Spinach & Feta Orzo
instructions: Sauté orzo in oil 1 minute; add broth and simmer 9-10 minutes.
Stir in spinach until wilted.
Finish with lemon zest and feta; serve warm.

recipes.name: Oven-Braised Beef with Onions & Carrots
ingredients: 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tbsp brown sugar
2 tbsp oil, 1 tsp paprika, garlic powder, salt, pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F. Sear seasoned beef in oil in a Dutch oven, 3 minutes per side; remove.
Soften onions 5 minutes; stir in tomato paste, sugar, and broth.
Return beef, add carrots, cover tightly, and braise 2.5 hours until fork-tender.
Slice or shred; spoon the soft onions and carrots over; keep pieces small for the toddler.

recipes.name: Pasta Primavera
instructions: Cook pasta and drain, saving a cup of water.
Sauté vegetables in oil with garlic 5 minutes.
Toss with pasta, lemon, and a splash of pasta water.

recipes.name: Pesto Gnocchi with Peas
instructions: Boil gnocchi until they float, adding peas for the last minute; drain.
Toss with pesto and a splash of cooking water.
Top with parmesan and serve; halve gnocchi for the toddler.

recipes.name: Quick Beef & Potato Stew
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, small cubes
instructions: Brown beef in oil; add onion and tomato paste for 2 minutes.
Add broth, carrots, and potatoes; bring to a boil.
Simmer covered 25-30 minutes until tender.
Mash a toddler portion with a fork.

recipes.name: Quick Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Simmer chicken in broth with vegetables 15 minutes.
Remove chicken, shred, and return to the pot.
Add noodles and cook 6-7 minutes.
Season, cool, and serve with small noodles for the toddler.

recipes.name: Salmon Patties with Cucumber Salad
instructions: Mix salmon, crumbs, egg, and mustard; form small patties.
Pan-fry in oil 3-4 minutes per side until golden.
Serve with cucumber salad; check for bones.

recipes.name: Shakshuka with Feta
instructions: Sauté onion and pepper in oil 5 minutes; add spices and tomatoes.
Simmer 10 minutes, then make wells and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook 5-6 minutes until whites set; top with feta.
Serve with pita; mild spice for the toddler.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Chicken Thighs & Roasted Veggies
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a sheet pan with foil.
Toss carrots and potatoes with half the oil and spices; spread on the pan.
Rub chicken with remaining oil and spices; nestle among the vegetables, skin up.
Roast 35 minutes until chicken hits 165°F and veggies are tender.
Rest 5 minutes. Shred a portion finely for the toddler.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Chickpeas & Veggies
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F; toss everything with oil and spices.
Roast 25 minutes, stirring once.
Serve over rice; mash chickpeas lightly for the toddler.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Lemon Chicken with Asparagus & Cherry Tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Toss chicken with 2 tbsp oil, lemon, and seasoning on a sheet pan.
Add asparagus and tomatoes drizzled with remaining oil.
Roast 18-22 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender.
Slice thinly; cut asparagus tips small for the toddler.

recipes.name: Sloppy Joes with Carrot Sticks
instructions: Brown beef with onion 6-7 minutes; drain extra fat.
Stir in tomato sauce, sugar, and mustard; simmer 10 minutes.
Spoon onto buns; serve with carrot sticks.
Serve the toddler's portion in a bowl with a fork.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker BBQ Pulled Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in the slow cooker; whisk BBQ sauce, broth, and sugar and pour over.
Cook on low 6 hours or high 3-4 hours.
Shred with two forks and stir back into the sauce.
Serve on buns or over rice; the shredded texture is ideal for the toddler.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Brisket with Carrots & Potatoes
ingredients: 1/2 cup broth, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp paprika, garlic powder, salt
instructions: Season brisket and sear 3 minutes per side in a hot pan if you have time.
Layer onion in the slow cooker, add brisket, then pour over sauce, broth, and sugar; surround with vegetables.
Cook on low 8-9 hours until fork-tender.
Slice against the grain; chop small pieces with soft vegetables for the toddler.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Cheesy Potato Soup
instructions: Add potatoes, onion, broth, butter, and seasoning to the slow cooker.
Cook on low 6 hours until potatoes are very soft; mash partly in the pot.
Stir in milk and cheese until melted.
Serve warm with a spoonful of peas or corn.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Cholent
ingredients: 2 lb beef flanken or chuck, cubed
1 cup dried kidney or white beans, rinsed
2 tbsp oil, 1 tbsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, salt and pepper
instructions: Layer onion, beans, barley, meat, and potatoes in the slow cooker; sprinkle with spices and oil.
Add water to just cover the ingredients.
Cook on low 10-12 hours (or overnight) until beans and meat are very tender.
Serve warm; mash potatoes and beans together for the toddler.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Creamy Tomato Soup
ingredients: Grilled cheese or crackers for dipping
instructions: Add tomatoes, onion, garlic, and broth to the slow cooker.
Cook on low 5 hours, then blend smooth with an immersion blender.
Stir in cream and warm through.
Serve with dippers; cool a bowl for the toddler.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Lentil & Vegetable Stew
ingredients: 2 cloves garlic, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika
instructions: Add everything to the slow cooker and stir.
Cook on low 6-7 hours until lentils are soft.
Season to taste; serve with bread or rice.
Mash a portion lightly for the toddler.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Mild Chana Masala
ingredients: 2 tsp mild curry powder, 1 tsp cumin
instructions: Combine all ingredients in the slow cooker.
Cook on low 5-6 hours until the sauce thickens.
Stir and season; serve over rice.
Mash chickpeas lightly and keep spices mild for the toddler.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Pot Roast
ingredients: 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tsp thyme, salt and pepper
instructions: Season roast and place on the onion in the slow cooker; add tomato paste, broth, and thyme.
Add carrots, celery, and potatoes around the meat.
Cook on low 8 hours until it shreds easily.
Shred and serve with vegetables and gravy from the pot.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Salsa Chicken Tacos
instructions: Combine chicken, salsa, seasoning, and corn in the slow cooker.
Cook on low 5-6 hours or high 3 hours.
Shred chicken and stir through the sauce.
Serve in tortillas; deconstruct into a bowl for the toddler.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Sweet & Sour Meatballs
ingredients: 1.5 lb frozen or homemade beef meatballs
1 cup grape jelly or apricot jam
instructions: Stir jelly, chili sauce, and lemon juice together in the slow cooker.
Add meatballs and turn to coat.
Cook on low 4 hours until heated through and glazed.
Serve over rice; halve meatballs for the toddler.

recipes.name: Spinach & Feta Egg Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Whisk eggs with milk; stir in spinach and feta.
Pour into a greased baking dish.
Bake 20-22 minutes until set in the center.
Cut into soft squares for the toddler; serve with warm pita.

recipes.name: Spinach & Ricotta Pasta Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F; cook penne until just short of done.
Mix ricotta, spinach, and egg; fold in pasta and half the marinara.
Pour into a dish, top with remaining sauce and mozzarella.
Bake 20 minutes; cool before serving.

recipes.name: Sunflower Butter Noodles
instructions: Cook noodles and drain.
Whisk sunflower butter, soy sauce, honey, vinegar, and warm water.
Toss with noodles and vegetables; serve warm or cold.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato & Black Bean Tacos
instructions: Roast sweet potatoes with oil and spices at 425°F for 20 minutes.
Warm beans and tortillas.
Fill and top with avocado; mash potato and beans for the toddler.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato Black Bean Enchiladas
instructions: Roast or microwave sweet potatoes until soft; mix with beans and cumin.
Fill tortillas, roll, and set in a dish.
Cover with sauce and cheese; bake at 375°F for 18 minutes.
Serve soft pieces to the toddler.

recipes.name: Teriyaki Chicken Bowls
instructions: Sear chicken in oil 6-7 minutes until golden.
Add broccoli and a splash of water; cover 3 minutes.
Pour in teriyaki sauce and toss until glossy.
Serve over rice; keep sauce light for the toddler.

recipes.name: Teriyaki Salmon Bowls
instructions: Roast salmon brushed with teriyaki at 400°F for 12 minutes.
Flake over rice with vegetables.
Check for bones and serve a mild portion to the toddler.

recipes.name: Tofu Scramble & Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Roast potatoes with oil at 425°F for 22 minutes.
Sauté pepper, then add crumbled tofu and spices for 6 minutes.
Serve scramble with potatoes.

recipes.name: Tuna Pasta with Peas
instructions: Cook pasta, adding peas in the last 2 minutes; drain, reserving 1/4 cup water.
Toss pasta and peas with tuna, olive oil, lemon juice, and reserved water.
Season to taste. Flake tuna finely for the toddler's portion.

recipes.name: Turkey & Rice Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Brown turkey with onion 6 minutes.
Mix with rice, half the sauce, and seasoning.
Stuff peppers, top with remaining sauce, cover with foil.
Bake 25 minutes; serve the filling mashed for the toddler.

recipes.name: Turkey Burgers & Sweet Potato Fries
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Toss sweet potato fries with oil; roast 20-25 minutes.
Mix turkey, breadcrumbs, egg, and seasoning; form 4-5 patties.
Pan-sear patties 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through.
Serve on buns with fries; dice a patty small for the toddler.

recipes.name: Turkey Chili
instructions: Sauté onion in oil until soft, 4 minutes.
Add turkey and cook until browned, 6-7 minutes.
Stir in beans, tomatoes, and spices; simmer 15 minutes.
Cool and mash slightly for the toddler; serve with rice or bread.
sides: Baked sweet potato or brown rice

recipes.name: Turkey Meatballs with Spaghetti
instructions: Mix turkey, breadcrumbs, egg, and seasoning; roll into 16-18 meatballs.
Brown in oil, about 5 minutes.
Pour marinara over, cover, and simmer 10 minutes.
Cook spaghetti; serve together, cut small for the toddler.

recipes.name: Turkey Taco Rice Skillet
instructions: Brown turkey in a large skillet 6 minutes.
Stir in rice, broth, seasoning, and salsa; cover and simmer 18 minutes.
Fold in corn and rest 5 minutes.
Fluff and serve; avocado on the side.

recipes.name: Vegetable Dumpling Soup
ingredients: 2 cups baby bok choy or spinach
instructions: Simmer broth with carrot and soy sauce 5 minutes.
Add dumplings and cook per package directions.
Add greens for 2 minutes; cut dumplings small for the toddler.

recipes.name: Vegetable Minestrone
instructions: Sauté vegetables in oil 5 minutes.
Add broth, tomatoes, beans, and herbs; simmer 15 minutes.
Add pasta and cook 8 minutes; serve with bread.

recipes.name: Veggie & Cheddar Omelette
ingredients: 1/2 cup diced bell pepper and spinach
instructions: Whisk eggs with a splash of water.
Melt butter in a nonstick skillet; sauté vegetables 2-3 minutes.
Pour in eggs, sprinkle cheese, and cook until just set, folding gently.
Serve with toast, cut into strips for the toddler.

recipes.name: Veggie Frittata with Toast
instructions: Sauté vegetables in an oven-safe pan 4 minutes.
Pour in whisked eggs and cook 3 minutes.
Bake at 400°F for 10 minutes until set; slice into wedges.

recipes.name: Veggie Lo Mein
ingredients: 12 oz lo mein or spaghetti noodles
3 cups mixed vegetables (carrots, cabbage, snap peas)
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions; drain.
Stir-fry vegetables and garlic in vegetable oil 4-5 minutes.
Add noodles, soy sauce, and sesame oil; toss until combined.
Cut noodles shorter for easier eating for the toddler.

recipes.name: Veggie Stir-Fry with Tofu & Rice
instructions: Crisp tofu in oil over medium-high heat, about 6 minutes.
Add vegetables, garlic, and ginger; stir-fry 5 minutes.
Stir in soy sauce and sesame oil.
Serve over rice; chop smaller for the toddler and go light on soy sauce.

recipes.name: Warm Caprese Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions; reserve 1/4 cup pasta water.
Toss hot pasta with olive oil, tomatoes, and a splash of pasta water.
Fold in mozzarella so it melts slightly. Top with basil.
Chop small for the toddler and let cool a moment before serving.
